items.title: Caleb Douglas: On track to be available Sunday
items.text:
Douglas (undisclosed) practiced Wednesday in a non-contact jersey, but he said he will play Sunday against  the Bills, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

items.title: T.J. Hockenson: Chance to return in Week 11
items.text:
Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that the Vikings hope Hockenson (wrist/chest) returns to action Sunday against the 49ers in Mexico City, Kevin Seifert of ESPN.com reports.
